deliverables.name: Repository reality determination
deliverables.note: The owner states the inventory; the delta is the registration census reconciled against the portfolio rollup and the certified scope at HEAD.
deliverables.subject: What the repository actually contains, as measured rather than asserted.

deliverables.name: Substrate census
deliverables.note: No owner exists for the substrate set of this programme; it is computed. A substrate outside version control is reported as such and never treated as Repository Truth.
deliverables.subject: Every machine-readable substrate this programme reads, with its tracking state, parse result and content hash.

deliverables.name: Reuse disposition
deliverables.note: Computed from the declaration itself: this is the mechanized zero-duplication invariant.
deliverables.subject: The repository-wide reuse disposition over all thirty-two bindings.

deliverables.name: Duplication — content identity
deliverables.note: Structural duplication only. Semantic duplication is not claimed.
deliverables.subject: Distinct registered artifacts sharing one content hash.

deliverables.name: Duplication — name identity
deliverables.note: A shared name is recorded, not adjudicated: naming authority belongs to the registration owner.
deliverables.subject: Distinct registered artifacts sharing one name.

deliverables.name: Duplication — registration delta
deliverables.note: A non-zero delta is a projection-staleness finding for the registration owner, never repaired here.
deliverables.subject: The registration census against every other projection that restates it.

deliverables.name: Duplication — multi-home concepts
deliverables.note: Canonical-home uniqueness is measured, not asserted.
deliverables.subject: One identifier or one path claimed by more than one registered record.

deliverables.name: Duplication — deliverable overlap
deliverables.note: The programme's own non-proliferation check: it may not create two homes for one fact.
deliverables.subject: One canonical owner claimed by more than one of the thirty-two deliverables.

deliverables.name: Conflict — declared conflicts
deliverables.note: The owner records the governance gaps; the delta counts the blocking findings and the certification ceiling at HEAD.
deliverables.subject: Conflicts, findings and open questions already declared by their own owners.

deliverables.name: Conflict — status vocabulary
deliverables.note: Two status vocabularies coexist by construction — the registration vocabulary and the constitutional state machine. The overlap is measured; neither is corrected.
deliverables.subject: Registered status values that are absent from the meta-constitutional state set.

deliverables.name: Conflict — live dependency on superseded truth
deliverables.note: Computed by joining the edge set to the registered status of both endpoints.
deliverables.subject: An edge whose target is superseded and whose source is not.

deliverables.name: Conflict — determination conflict set
deliverables.note: No winner is elected. Adjudication belongs to the authority that owns the conflicting determinations.
deliverables.subject: Located determinations whose verdicts do not agree, with each verdict's scope.

deliverables.name: Gap — deliverable gaps
deliverables.note: No chartered deliverable is wholly unobtainable; what the non-derivable register records is narrower — a bounded refusal inside a deliverable, each naming the deliverable whose claim it caps.
deliverables.subject: Deliverables for which no honest derivation is possible.

deliverables.name: Gap — executability gaps
deliverables.note: The owner registers the gates; the delta is the measured automation presence of each located engine.
deliverables.subject: Constitutional gates that are enforceable but not enforced.

deliverables.name: Gap — dimension gaps
deliverables.note: The owner presents the control tower; the delta is per-dimension occupancy computed from its own projection.
deliverables.subject: Execution dimensions that are not complete.

deliverables.name: Gap — traceability gaps
deliverables.note: The owner determines the traceability graph; the delta is the measured fill ratio across the thirteen traceability dimensions.
deliverables.subject: Registered artifacts whose traceability is incomplete, and by how much.

deliverables.name: Gap — open-work gaps
deliverables.note: Deciding a matter is not discharging the work it names: registered work packages are counted, never closed.
deliverables.subject: Work that is registered but not discharged.

deliverables.name: Completeness per dimension
deliverables.note: A lower bound only. Absence of a measurement is never read as completeness.
deliverables.subject: Per-dimension completeness, declared as a lower bound.

deliverables.name: Readiness determination
deliverables.note: The owner declares readiness and its ceiling; the delta is tier occupancy, vacancy count and ceiling size at HEAD.
deliverables.subject: Readiness and the declared certification ceiling.

deliverables.name: Blocked-by set
deliverables.note: Computed from the blockers, vacancies, open questions and undischarged gates their owners declare.
deliverables.subject: What each blocked determination is blocked by, and who owns the unblocking act.

deliverables.name: Automation presence
deliverables.note: Presence only. Automatability is not claimed, and an absent binding is not a defect of the engine.
deliverables.subject: Automation presence per located engine and per gate.

deliverables.name: Catalogue owner binding
deliverables.note: Pointer row only; the catalogue is not restated, extended or counted here.
deliverables.subject: The canonical capability catalogue.

deliverables.name: Registry owner binding
deliverables.note: The owner is the registry; the delta is the registered census, the meta-constitutional artifact count, and which declared registers are located.
deliverables.subject: The universal artifact registry.

deliverables.name: Ontology owner binding
deliverables.note: Pointer row only. Per-universe ontologies are owned by their own bands and are not aggregated here.
deliverables.subject: The ontology register.

deliverables.name: Taxonomy owner binding
deliverables.note: Pointer row only.
deliverables.subject: The substrate taxonomy home and root taxa anchor.

deliverables.name: API and interface owner binding
deliverables.note: The owner catalogues the public interface; the delta is its own accounting and the subsystem census.
deliverables.subject: The public interface catalogue.

deliverables.name: Engine catalogue
deliverables.note: Discovered by declared glob over tracked files only. An untracked engine is not Repository Truth.
deliverables.subject: Executable governance engines present in version control, joined to their gate, entry point and workflow bindings.

deliverables.name: Graph owner binding and edge reconciliation
deliverables.note: The owner is the graph registry; the delta reconciles the edge census against the portfolio rollup and the certified scope.
deliverables.subject: The knowledge-graph registry and the edge-count reconciliation across projections.

deliverables.name: Capability edge census
deliverables.note: Counted from the graph projection and the inherited resilience contract. No capability is created, renamed or retired.
deliverables.subject: The edge-type census, including the capability-bearing relationship types.

deliverables.name: Decision intelligence
deliverables.note: The owner determines the lifecycle; the delta is measured occupancy across stages and the closed disposition set.
deliverables.subject: Decision lifecycle occupancy, disposition occupancy, and deliverable-to-decision coverage.

deliverables.name: Validation, certification and compliance binding
deliverables.note: The owner determines certification intelligence; the delta reconciles certified scope against the registration census and reports the ceiling.
deliverables.subject: The validation, certification and constitutional-compliance owners, plus the certification-scope reconciliation.

deliverables.name: Evolution and master roadmap binding
deliverables.note: The owner holds the roadmap in prose; the delta is the executable-owner census and the counted absence of any machine-readable execution sequence.
deliverables.subject: The evolution owner and the master execution roadmap, plus the executable-owner delta.

modes.definition: A canonical owner exists and is current. The programme emits a pointer row only. No content is restated.
A canonical owner exists. The programme emits the pointer plus a delta the owner does not contain — staleness against HEAD, a coverage ratio, or a scope gap.
No canonical owner exists. The programme computes the fact from declared substrate.
No substrate exists. The programme emits verified absence with a counted probe and the evidence class that would be required. Never a body, never a row.

non_derivable.fact: Whether the repository is constitutionally complete.
non_derivable.reason: Completeness is a ratification verdict. The constitutional tier competent to ratify is declared VACANT by its own registry, so no located authority can issue it and this programme may not substitute for one.
non_derivable.required_evidence_class: A ratification determination issued by a constituted authority occupying the vacant tier.

non_derivable.fact: The master execution sequence in machine-readable form.
non_derivable.reason: The roadmap is held in prose by its owner. No machine-readable execution sequence exists in version control, and deriving one would create a second sequencing authority.
non_derivable.required_evidence_class: A machine-readable execution sequence emitted by the located roadmap owner.

non_derivable.reason: Four of the declared registers do not exist in version control. Rollback capability that rests on them cannot be measured, and the registers may not be authored by this programme.
non_derivable.required_evidence_class: The four declared registers, authored and committed by their located owner.

non_derivable.fact: Off-machine existence of the constitutional baseline anchor.
non_derivable.reason: The branch carrying the baseline has no configured upstream, so durability of every claim resting on the anchor cannot be verified from the repository. Configuring or pushing one is an operator act, not a determination.
non_derivable.required_evidence_class: A configured upstream and a pushed anchor, verifiable independently of this machine.

non_derivable.fact: Reproduction of prior authorization seals from committed history alone.
non_derivable.reason: Programme evidence zones are excluded from version control by the ignore authority. Their contents are therefore not Repository Truth, and a seal over them cannot be recomputed from history.
non_derivable.required_evidence_class: Either evidence committed to version control, or a deterministic regeneration path proven from committed inputs alone.

programme.disclosure: CERTIFIED-PROVISIONAL; constitutional Tier T1 is VACANT (VAC-01 / CMG-OQ-02 / UCCEP-F-004); every determination is PROVISIONAL under CMG-000001 CMG-L-12. Nothing here is ratified, final or frozen.
programme.mission: Establish Repository Truth for the thirty-two deliverables the charter names. Create no catalogue, no registry, no roadmap and no authority. Where a canonical owner already exists, bind it by reference and never restate it; where none exists, derive the fact from machine-readable repository truth; where honest derivation is impossible, declare and count the absence.
